artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan reconciling four MCP registration/permission surfaces in the agent-system source store (redundant playwright enumerations, five dead manifest mcp_servers fields, ownership doc, nix README), plus two consequential doc-staleness sites item 1 creates.

memory_candidates.content: check-extension-docs.sh (the 'doc-lint' gate) sets EXT_DIR to $REPO_ROOT/agent-system/extensions -- the SOURCE STORE -- not the deployed .claude/extensions/ tree, despite its own header comment and startup banner both claiming it 'iterates .claude/extensions/*/'. Consequence: doc-lint covers EVERY source extension including ones not loaded in the current repo (web, present, filetypes, founder are lintable in a repo whose .claude/extensions/ holds only core, email, lean, literature, memory, nix). Two corollaries for plan/verification design: (1) a doc-lint gate over an unloaded extension does NOT require a deploy first; (2) the 'WARN: README.md older than manifest.json' and 'routing target not deployed' lines are info-level only -- they do not set EXTENSION_STATUS or increment FAILURES, so they never affect the exit code. Verify a gate script's actual root variable before assuming its banner text.
